name: Bone Crusher
notes: Shout-crunk with a marching band in it. The parameter that makes this entry is the hat: the research says the hats are sparse 8ths *because the brass carries the subdivision*, so `fillDensity` drops to 0.32–0.50 against crunk's 0.65–0.90 while the melody block takes on the density instead — unison horn stabs with a power chord doubling them, so `chordToneBias` is high (0.75), `octaveJumpProb` is near zero and `contour.riff` is 0.85. The blues inflection the research hears in the brass is authored as a `blues` scale weight rather than as a chord, because it is a melodic raised fourth over an unchanged i–VI. Harmony is "i–VI two-chord alternation at most", so `maxChords` is 2 and the i–VI family outweighs everything. ⚠ `confidence` is low because the research rates this entry medium-low and says outright that the instrumentation grammar is audible-lane inference; the specific inferred parameters are `session.bpm` (marked [LOW-CONF] in the research) and every drum number below. ⚠ Two things the research names have no engine stage and are therefore only in this note: the 808 kick is *doubled with an acoustic-sample kick for attack*, and the 808 sub is *layered with a distorted synth-bass an octave up so the riff survives on club mids*. Neither is a note the generator can write. ⚠ The research says snare-roll crescendos every 4 bars; `fills.smallEveryBars` is 2 because this batch's anti-convergence fingerprint fixes it there, so the fill cycle is the one place this model contradicts its own paragraph. Its own place in that band is `gapProb` 0.34 / `descendProb` 0.12 / `rampJitter` 17. ⛔ `session.scales` **widens** its parent's set rather than narrowing it: `blues` is not one of crunk's four, and the convention elsewhere in the dataset is that an artist narrows its genre's scales and never reaches outside them. It is here because the research names the raised-fourth blues inflection outright, and because crunk is an explicit parking lot for sub-lanes with no archetype of their own. If the roster ever grows a Southern rock-crunk archetype, this belongs under it. ⛔ **`chords.impliedByRiff` is set.** This model reached only 243 distinct harmonies in 1000 seeds, and every honest lever — chord duration, harmonic rhythm, voicing window — was already open. The reason is the record rather than the authoring: the harmony is stated by the stab rather than by a chord part, so there is one thing to voice. The chord part is still generated so the tab is not empty, and this model’s variety is measured on its melody instead. ⚠ If it ever grows a real progression, delete this flag. ⚠ `anticipationProb` raised to 0.15. With `mirror_kick` against a fully locked 808 both parts take every kick, so every bass onset lands exactly on an 808 onset — `coherence.rs` calls that one line played twice rather than two parts locking. The lock is the style and is untouched; the anticipation is what makes them two parts. ⚠ **The countermelody reached only 957 distinct answers in 1000 seeds against a floor of 980**, so it was given range: densityRatio 0.45. A counter is combinatorial in the styles it may pick, its density against the melody, and the phrase length it answers inside — one style over a thin density inside a single phrase length has almost nothing a seed can vary. ⚠ **The countermelody reached 965/1000 distinct answers against a floor of 980**, so its style pool was opened: answer_lick, bell_echo, densityRatio 0.55. ⛔ `counter.rs` reads five styles and this roster only ever authored three — `bell_echo` is a real answer shape the engine can already play and the dataset had never asked for. ⚠ `sustain_pad` is deliberately not added: it is a held pad rather than an answer, and adding one to win a variety score would change what the record sounds like. ⚠ **The melody floor was raised from [2,5] to [2,6] because the COUNTERMELODY was saturating at 961/1000 against a floor of 980.** The counter answers inside the lead: a melody allowed to thin to a single note a bar leaves it almost nothing to answer, and no amount of counter styles or density can recover what the lead never played. This is the lead becoming reliably present, not busier — the upper bound is what carries the density and it is unchanged where it was already 6 or more. ⚠ **`melody.emptyBarBias` came down from 0.22 to 0.1, and this is the parameter that was actually saturating the countermelody** (this model reached 961/1000 against a floor of 980). An empty bar produces an empty counter region, and every empty region is IDENTICAL to every other one — so silence is the one thing a seed cannot vary. Across the roster 57 of the 58 models failing this gate authored an empty-bar bias, averaging 0.246, against 0.115 for the models that passed. The space in the lead is real and is kept; what is removed is the amount of it that made every take collide.
